score_note: Canonical quality scores supported; IAS NS because market execution and post-IPO deployment are insufficiently verified.

GOV.reason: Named related pay is about 19.7% of annual PAT and legacy MSME restatement is material enough to monitor. Loans were repaid and audited statements reconcile; no diversion or current qualification established. Sparse post-listing issuer indexes limit confidence.

MOAT.reason: Process-specific qualification, custom catalysts and export manufacturing support switching friction. Concentration increased, supplier dependence is high and no quantified patent/price-premium evidence supports a stronger moat.

REV.reason: Five-year verified revenue CAGR exceeds 30%, putting growth in the highest historical band, capped at 8 for medium confidence. Recent headline growth is only 4.86%, but manufacturing grew 28.9% as trading shrank. Scope is the same issuer; no acquisition inflation established.

DUR.reason: High overall utilization and explicitly financed 5,088 MT expansion create an identifiable runway. Product qualifications, concentrated customers and falling catalyst/adsorbent tonnage make commissioning and demand conversion uncertain; capacity is not an order book.

CAP.reason: Core EBIT 16.20 crore relative to closing equity plus debt less cash about 33.83 crore indicates strong accounting returns, and EBIT rose 5.79 crore on increased capital. Inventory-funded profits and much larger forthcoming IPO capital prevent extrapolating historical return ratios into incremental project returns.

CASH.reason: Three-year CFO/PAT about 0.382 and two of three years negative after capex show weak conversion despite positive CFO in all three years. FY 2026 finished-goods accumulation and receivables absorb profit; no repeated negative CFO or unsupported <=3 persistent override is imposed.

BAL.reason: Pre-IPO debt is only 2.50 crore and net IPO funding 35.08 crore finances expansion without immediate high leverage. Deposits are not all freely available and proceeds are earmarked, preventing a maximum score or treating issue cash as excess.

EXEC.reason: Manufacturing/export sales and total production increased with high utilization. Catalyst/adsorbent tonnage fell, stock rose sharply and the new factory has not yet demonstrated cash returns, so technical progress is not equated to fully proven scalable execution.

EARN.reason: PAT rose 63.2% and core EBIT 55.6%, supported by manufacturing mix rather than merely other income. Inventory capitalization and low cash conversion materially temper earnings quality; do not assign a top score.

sections.title: Executive Verdict
sections.text: Manufacturing growth is materially stronger than the 4.9% headline revenue increase, but cash conversion is much weaker than the 63% profit increase. New IPO funding can nearly double capacity, yet finished goods, customer concentration and qualification-led demand make execution critical. A technical manufacturing watchlist, not a buy based on pre-IPO EPS. [S1][S2]

sections.title: Research Header, Gates and Data Confidence
sections.text: Devson Catalyst Limited, formerly Devson Insulators, incorporated 10 September 2004 and renamed in 2017; BSE SME 544823, DEVSON, ISIN INE2KRP01017, listed 16 July 2026. Standalone accounts and current 13,588,000 shares are used. Cutoff 20 October 2026, five-year horizon, 15% nominal pre-tax hurdle and Rs 5 lakh illustrative position. The Rs 372 secondary daily close is dated 19 October, not independently exchange-verified. [S9] [S1][S2][S4][S5]

sections.title: Scorecard and Calculation Audit
sections.text: BQS and Growth Quality use canonical weighted factors with medium confidence; IAS is NS. Statements and cash closing balances reconcile, and disclosed restatement adjustments explain historical differences. No critical financial-reliability hold is inferred from the editorial chronology note or a correction alone. Missing current deployment and live market-execution data limits attractiveness, not all business factors. [S1][S2]

sections.title: Business Overview
sections.text: Catalysts, adsorbents and ceramic balls support refining, petrochemicals, steel and fertilizer processes. Customers buy performance and qualification, not merely commodity tonnage; manufacturing and product trading have different economics. FY 2026 manufactured sales Rs 51.62 crore versus Rs 40.05 crore, while trading fell Rs 12.83 crore to Rs 3.61 crore. Export manufactured sales rose Rs 13.28 crore to Rs 20.60 crore. Revenue therefore understates the mix shift, but does not by itself demonstrate pricing power. [S1][S2]

sections.title: Moat / Industry Position
sections.text: Customer qualification, tailored process performance and export track record provide switching friction. Counterweights are top-five sales concentration of 60.12%, no assured long-term customer commitments and top-ten supplier concentration of 75.82%. Industrial catalyst incumbents and customer-specific approval cycles can delay entry despite lower domestic costs. Patents, market share and durable price premiums were not independently established. [S2]

sections.title: Revenue Growth & Scale
sections.text: FY 2021 operating revenue was Rs 14.44 crore and total income Rs 14.68 crore and PAT Rs 1.22 crore; restated FY 2024/25/26 revenue was Rs 43.47/53.19/55.78 crore and PAT Rs 4.08/7.67/12.52 crore. Historical growth is strong, but FY 2026 growth decelerated. Core EBITDA grew Rs 10.93 crore to Rs 16.76 crore; other income Rs 1.07 crore is removed from that measure. Finished-goods inventory rose more than twentyfold to Rs 4.88 crore: profitable production is not equivalent to cash realization. Restated incentives are in revenue for comparable recent years. [S1][S2][S3]

sections.title: Growth Quality & Reinvestment Runway
sections.text: Current 6,205 MT capacity operated at 86.83% aggregate utilization, but catalyst/adsorbent output fell about 8.1% while ceramics rose. Additional 5,088 MT catalyst/adsorbent capacity is planned, supported by Rs 17.40 crore IPO capex allocation. The Rs 12 crore working-capital object supports sales ramp-up, not automatic incremental revenue. Commissioning, customer qualification and cash collection must be demonstrated; September product/order headlines are not included as quantified earnings because the underlying attachment was not reviewed. [S2]

sections.title: Management, Governance & Execution
sections.text: Six disclosed family salaries total Rs 2.47 crore, about 19.7% of PAT. Related goods purchases are relatively small at Rs 0.12 crore; related loans were repaid before listing. This is neither a clean governance certificate nor evidence of diversion. Historical MSME-interest restatement, delayed-tax interest and dependence on promoter technical leadership warrant monitoring. Prospectus no-pledge disclosure is dated July; issuer current ownership/disclosure pages still say Coming soon, so current pledge status is not certified. [S1][S2][S6][S7]

sections.title: Financial Forensics
sections.text: FY 2024–26 CFO totals Rs 9.26 crore versus PAT Rs 24.27 crore, about 0.382 x. FY 2026 CFO Rs 4.56 crore less capex Rs 5.29 crore gives FCF minus Rs 0.74 crore. Inventory increased Rs 4.98 crore and receivables Rs 4.09 crore; reported receivable cash movement differs because unrealized FX is separately adjusted. Three-year cash is weak, but all three CFO figures remain positive. The Rs 0.3246 crore GST appeal is about 2.6% of FY 2026 PAT, not a solvency issue. FY 2024 restatement equity reduction Rs 0.3281 crore is disclosed and traced; it is economically relevant but not unexplained missing cash. [S1][S2]

sections.title: Valuation & Market Expectations
sections.text: The post-IPO share base reduces FY 2026 per-share earnings to about Rs 9.21, versus pre-IPO annual EPS around Rs 12.21. At the secondary Rs 372 close, implied earnings multiple is about 40.4 x and lot cost Rs 4.464 lakh, nearly the entire illustrative position. Company fresh proceeds are Rs 39.39 crore gross, Rs 35.08 crore net; the OFS belongs to selling holders. Annual models start from actual operating working capital, add net issue funding once, charge capex and changing working capital separately, and retain a Rs 5.69 crore GCP reserve. They are sensitivities, not fair-value targets or current cash estimates. [S1][S2][S4][S5] Model correction dated 20 October 2026: the earlier forecast omitted certain opening liabilities excluded from operating working capital. The revised model pays opening net tax and other current claims once, preserves actual opening assets/debt, and explicitly retains noncurrent employee claims in terminal equity with separate settlement sensitivities. This corrects our forecast, not the issuer’s financial statements. No liability is paid twice through working capital, debt, capex or recurring compensation. Corrected bear/base/bull terminal prices are ₹120.59/₹420.58/₹1040.98; corresponding five-year returns are -20.17%/2.49%/22.85%. These remain conditional operating and funding scenarios, not executable entry prices. Opening-claim amounts, timing alternatives and annual cash/debt checks are in the model. [S1]

sections.title: Bear Case & Permanent-Loss Path
sections.text: Customer loss, delayed qualification or inventory obsolescence could combine with an oversized expansion. A 25% write-down of finished goods is Rs 1.22 crore before tax, about 9.7% of annual PAT; this is a stress, not an asserted impairment. Halving core EBITDA and applying 8 x produces enterprise value near Rs 67.06 crore, or about Rs 49.35 per share before net cash/debt and project recovery; not a price floor. Secondary OHLCV covers all 60 postlisting reference dates; low-times-volume estimates imply about 0.53 sessions at 5% participation, but these are not actual observed turnover or executable fractional lots. Official spreads, depth, circuits and current BSE surveillance remain unverified. [S9] Large lot size alone makes a Rs 5 lakh position unusually concentrated. [S1][S2][S4]

sections.title: 5× / 10× Feasibility
sections.text: Fivefold return in five years requires 38.0% annual per-share compounding and tenfold 58.5%. Even 30% revenue growth with sustained high margins does not guarantee these returns from a high starting multiple. Expansion must convert into qualified sales, collections and returns on the much larger capital base without repeated dilution. No multibagger probability is assigned.

sections.title: Monitoring Plan
sections.text: Track finished goods versus invoiced sales and subsequent receipts; catalyst/adsorbent tonnage versus value; customer and supplier concentration; factory spending, commissioning and qualifications; IPO bank utilization and any change in objects. Obtain September ownership/pledges, the July presentation and September product announcement directly. Reassess margins if inventory remains elevated or export growth fails to produce cash. Verify full BSE liquidity and lot economics before any position. [S1][S2][S6][S7][S8]

sections.title: Final Classification & Conditional Action
sections.text: Deep primary-statement/prospectus review supports quality scoring, with medium-confidence business factors and low-confidence attractiveness. Hold for current valuation and deployment evidence. Reasonable attempts to review current issuer indexes and exchange presentation failed or found empty pages; this does not convert missing facts into positive assurances.

sections.title: Sources, Assumptions & Open Questions
sections.text: Primary annual statements, restated prospectus, historical annual financial summary and income statement, related-party notes, audit/CARO and security master were reviewed. The FY 2021 source is scanned; original older financial statements are not silently substituted for restated recent accounts. Current market price is a dated secondary close, not exchange-verified. [S9] Post-IPO deployment, current pledge details, commercial order economics and BSE live execution conditions remain explicitly unverified. [S1][S2][S3][S4][S5][S6][S7][S8]

valuation.opening_WC_formula: Inventory + receivables + GST/supplier/employee advances + current security/export/prepaid + noncurrent security/prepaid - trade payables - other current liabilities - current employee/CSR provisions; noncurrent gratuity is modeled separately; excludes cash/deposits, interest accrual, tax and IPO costs.
notes: All deposits excluded from available cash conservatively.
FY 2027 net IPO 35.0837 crore added once; OFS excluded. Prior paid IPO expenses 0.4568 crore are not released, making funding conservatively understated if fully included in total offer costs.
Debt assumed repaid/netted from IPO funds; no interest income or dividends assumed. If net cash turns negative, funding requirement is shown without pretending it is committed.
Additional capex 17.3984 crore FY 2027 plus annual 3% maintenance/replacement. Working-capital allocation 12 crore is NOT separately deducted because actual change in WC already enters FCFF.
Closing net cash reduced by 5.6853 crore unmodeled GCP reserve at exit; this is an assumption, not disclosed current restricted cash.
Terminal EV=year 5 EBITDA*multiple; equity=EV+net cash-GCP reserve; per share=equity*1 e 7/13,588,000; dividends zero; reference IRR=(exit/372)^(1/5)-1.
